'''Knattspyrnudeild Keflavíkur''' ({{IPA|is|ˈkʰnahtˌspɪ(r)tnʏˌteilt ˈcʰɛplaˌviːk}}, {{lit|Keflavík Football (Sub)Division}}) is an [[Iceland]]ic [[Association football|football]] team, commonly known as Keflavík.  It is a subdivision of [[Keflavík ÍF]] (Keflavík, íþrótta- og ungmennafélag), based in the town of [[Reykjanesbær]] in Iceland. They play at [[Keflavíkurvöllur|Nettó-völlur]] in Keflavík."}}
